global_prompt: Use IRIS MASTER. Professional near-photographic realism, physically plausible construction, accurate scale and materials, restrained grading, no obvious AI artifacts.
asset_lock: Preserve each asset's silhouette, proportions, functional geometry, markings and materials across all views. Distinct shapes must remain recognizable after conversion to isometric game graphics.
qa_prompt: Run the IRIS 10-expert panel. Reject critical/major geometry, material, lighting, continuity or compositing errors. Prefer local correction.

items.prompt: Full modern 3D high-resolution reference preview of the asset, front three-quarter view, neutral operational background, clear silhouette.
items.negative_prompt: no duplicate wheels, no malformed tracks, no fake text, no excessive HDR

items.prompt: Convert the locked asset into a clean RTS isometric in-game representation while preserving identity and readable silhouette.
items.negative_prompt: no redesign, no changed proportions, no extra turrets
